name: account-chooser
title: Account chooser
description: A 'Choose an account' list of the people already known on this device, with 'Use another account' and a remove control per row.
docs: accounts is the list of { id, name, email, avatar?, signedIn? }. Every row is one plain button with an avatar, the name, the address and a word for its state, Signed in, or Signed out with a lock so state never rests on colour, and its own menu button beside it, so Tab walks the list and there are no composite-widget keyboard rules. onChoose(account) may return a promise: that row alone shows Signing in and a rejection shows a message above the list. onUseAnother is the row under the list, which stays in view when more than six accounts make the list scroll inside the card (the list then shows half of the next row and a slim scrollbar that is always there, and takes no Tab stop of its own). onRemove(account) adds the menu with Remove from this device: choosing it turns the row into a question (Remove the address from this device?) with Keep focused and Escape to cancel; resolve onRemove and drop the account from accounts, and the focus moves to the next row (or the previous one, or Use another account). In a narrow card the state word drops under the address, so the name keeps the whole row. title, description, titleAs, footer and labels change the words; defaultConfirming opens a question for a preview, without taking the focus.
